The quarter's themes
at a glance
What shipped and the early signals, what is moving and what is blocked, and the one trade-off we cannot fund both sides of.
Priya Raman, Head of Product  ·  9 October 2026
twelve initiatives, one call to make
What landed, and the early signals
Live for every customer since August. Half of incident reviews now start from it.
P95 latency down 41%. The most-cited improvement in September customer calls.
Four enterprise customers live in week one. The bundle is now a sales asset.
the cache is what customers bring up first
Six initiatives moving, two more stuck behind a contract and a legal review. The board first, then the one call to make.
quiet rows are the good news
Two bets we cannot both fund
Every customer benefits on day one
The differentiator in every competitive deal
Three engineers and a vendor contract
A door that stays shut until it is built
four engineers, one quarter, pick one
Fund the narrative. Hold APAC to a date in Q1 and tell the two customers the truth about when.
a date they can plan around beats a maybe
Narrative funded to general availability; APAC held to 28 February. Both customers hear it this week.
Narrative beta opens to every customer on the incident plan. Mobile alerts ship.
The residency vendor closes. Two engineers start the region build with a date to hit.
Deal status, narrative adoption, and whether the February date still holds.
15 January is a checkpoint, not a courtesy
Narrative to general availability in Q4; APAC residency committed for 28 February. Revisit on 15 January with the deal status.
minutes out tonight, board updated by Friday
